record.question: He is extremely _________, he would believe anything you tell him.
record.explanation: Answer D: gullible. Gullible means easily persuaded to believe something, matching “he would believe anything you tell him” (D). Independent check: A gullible person readily believes what they are told. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/gullible; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/idiom; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses.
